requirements.text: Allow customers to book appointments online at any time, select services, choose barbers, and secure suitable time slots.
Enable customers to cancel or reschedule appointments independently to minimize disruptions.
Reduce no-shows through automated reminders sent before appointments.
Gain clear visibility into bookings, cancellations, and peak times for better management.
Provide a way for each barber to set their own schedules to avoid double bookings and maintain smooth operations.
The booking process must include a landing page showcasing available services.
Customers must be able to select their preferred barber.
Display real-time availability of time slots to avoid double bookings.
Customers must fill in their contact information and preferences when booking an appointment.
Provide a review step before finalizing the appointment.
Send immediate booking confirmation via SMS and email after confirming the appointment.
Send a 24-hour reminder before the appointment with key details.
Send a 1-hour reminder before the appointment with key details.
Barbers must set their own working hours and available days.
Barbers must have the option to add breaks during their shifts.
Barbers must mark specific days off easily through the system.
Changes made to barber schedules must update in real-time on the booking interface.
The system should notify barbers and the shop of any schedule changes.
Provide a daily booking summary report including total appointments, barber assignments, cancellations, and no-shows.
Provide a weekly overview report aggregating data from each day.
Track cancellation numbers and reasons provided by clients.
Track no-show histories for customers and flag repeat offenders for manual review.
Provide insights on peak booking times to help with staff scheduling and marketing efforts.
Analyze customer booking frequency, preferred services, and barbers to tailor offerings.
The solution must be cost-effective regarding both setup and ongoing operational expenses.
The system must ensure secure storage of personal data and comply with relevant data protection regulations.
The system should be user-friendly to minimize training time and disruption to daily operations.
The booking interface must be optimized for mobile devices.
The new system should integrate smoothly with existing tools and processes.
Consideration must be given to clients who may not be tech-savvy or prefer to book via phone.
